# The Weinstock Laser Eye Center (Weinstock Vision)

> Laser cataract surgery, LASIK, EVO ICL and lens replacement in Largo, FL with Dr. Robert J. Weinstock, a board-certified cataract and refractive surgeon.

Address: 1225 West Bay Drive, Largo, FL 33770. Phone: (727) 518-2020. Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 am to 5 pm. Surgeon: Robert J. Weinstock, MD.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://proposals.localairegistry.com/weinstock/): procedures, the surgeon, reviews, FAQ, map, hours and the consultation form.
- [Dr. Robert J. Weinstock, MD](https://proposals.localairegistry.com/weinstock/dr-robert-weinstock/): full bio with honors, leadership, training, research and sources.
- [Book a consultation](https://proposals.localairegistry.com/weinstock/#contact): request form; the practice calls back to schedule.
- [Contact](https://proposals.localairegistry.com/weinstock/contact/): phone, both offices, hours and map.
- [Largo office](https://proposals.localairegistry.com/weinstock/locations/largo/): main office at 1225 West Bay Drive, Largo, FL 33770, (727) 518-2020.
- [Clearwater office](https://proposals.localairegistry.com/weinstock/locations/clearwater/): 3220 McMullen Booth Road, Clearwater, FL 33761, (727) 581-8706.

## Procedures
- [Laser Cataract Surgery](https://proposals.localairegistry.com/weinstock/procedures/laser-cataract-surgery/): cloudy lens replaced with a clear lens, with laser precision.
- [Premium Lens Implants](https://proposals.localairegistry.com/weinstock/procedures/premium-lens-implants/): toric, multifocal and Light Adjustable Lens options.
- [LASIK](https://proposals.localairegistry.com/weinstock/procedures/lasik/): laser vision correction for nearsightedness, farsightedness and astigmatism.
- [EVO ICL](https://proposals.localairegistry.com/weinstock/procedures/evo-icl/): implantable lens for higher prescriptions or thin corneas.
- [Clear Lens Exchange](https://proposals.localairegistry.com/weinstock/procedures/clear-lens-exchange/): lens replacement for near and far vision after about 45.
